description: Varna (Varan) koota — temperament/spiritual-grade compatibility derived from the Moon rashi of each partner. Classical grouping by element: water = Brahmin, fire = Kshatriya, earth = Vaishya, air = Shudra. Directional: the groom's varna rank must be >= the bride's. This is a temperament ordering only, not a social value judgement.

varna_ranks._comment: Higher number = higher varna in the scoring order. Purely the classical scoring order.

scoring.roles: groom vs bride (seeker/partner mapped per manifest.role_mapping — PENDING OQ-2)
scoring.rule: Let g = varna_rank(groom.rashi), b = varna_rank(bride.rashi). If g >= b -> 1 point, else 0.

notes: Rashi->varna by element: Brahmin = Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces (water); Kshatriya = Aries, Leo, Sagittarius (fire); Vaishya = Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn (earth); Shudra = Gemini, Libra, Aquarius (air).
Directionality (which role must hold the higher/equal rank) depends on the confirmed bride/groom mapping — PENDING OQ-2. If the mapping is reversed the win/lose asymmetry flips.
Sanskrit term: Varna / Varan. Standard classification is well documented; the executable inclusion remains PENDING_DOMAIN_REVIEW against a frozen MC + Raman edition.
